evidence.why: Mapping, decoding, encoding selection and loading.
Texel output, expansion, initialization, texture and width queries.

facts.rationale: Preserves the supported encoding and CARD purpose while covering the rest of the canonical translation unit.
facts.value: Provides Dolphin OS system-font support: selects and caches ANSI or Shift-JIS from console video state, reads and decodes the corresponding ROM font into caller storage, expands packed sheets, maps character codes to glyphs, and supplies glyph texels, texture locations and widths. The encoding query also supplies the compatibility selection consumed by Memory Card formatting and ID validation.
